notes.title: Graphic Options Update!
notes.content:
[p]Thanks to your valuable feedback, I've rolled out some new features and improvements to the Graphic options:[/p][p][b]- Directional Display Option:[/b] You can now see all possible directions for a few seconds each time you enter a scene. ([i]This feature is disabled by default[/i] — enable it in the graphics panel if you want.)[/p][p][b]- Window Mode Switch:[/b] A new toggle button has been added to switch from Fullscreen mode to Windowed mode.[/p][p][b]- Tutorial Access:[/b] The tutorial button is now more visible and conveniently located in the main menu.[/p][p][b]- Camera Smoothing:[/b] I've smoothed out some camera rotations that were previously too fast for a better experience.

All these improvements can be tested in the demo.[/p][p]I appreciate your ongoing support and look forward to your feedback![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439988/a475c928da5ef03aabf79eb61d3c3a617ceb3613.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Enter Debut Festival 2025!
notes.content: [p]I’m thrilled to announce that Back in the Swamp has been chosen to participate in Debut Festival 2025! Thanks for your support—more updates soon![/p]

notes.title: WASD Controls Added in Response to Player Feedback
notes.content:
[p]I'm excited to announce a new feature in the game demo! Both navigation methods are always available, and you can use either to travel between scenes:[/p][list][*][p][b]Mouse Clicks:[/b] Click on the appearing arrows to move to a different scene.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keyboard Controls:[/b] Use the WASD keys (remappable in settings) to navigate to other scenes.[/p][/*][/list][p]Both methods perform the same function, so you can choose whichever you prefer each time you want to switch scenes.[/p][p]Update the demo now and explore using your preferred control method! [/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439988/e1c72cb7bb2ddbbd5a9069483c62983e57356342.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Thank You for Your Support — Latest Progress & News
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]I want to sincerely thank each of you for trying out the demo and sharing your valuable feedback. Your support means the world to me as I continue working on this project.[/p][p]This demo is a standalone prequel that offers a glimpse into the world and atmosphere of the full game. The coming months will now be dedicated to developing the levels of the main game.[/p][p]I will still be making a few modifications to the demo, including adding a tutorial page to the menu screen. Many players have provided feedback that they didn't realize they could move quickly by right-clicking, teleport directly to main locations via the map, or combine items through drag & drop directly into the inventory.[/p][p]Thanks again for your support. Stay tuned for more updates![/p][p]Best regards,
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439988/214e3e8cfd3a752663284aac1f42bd053583a0e2.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Demo in Closed Beta!
notes.content: [p]Demo is now in playtest and will be released this summer![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo is in progress!
notes.content: [p]The demo was originally intended to mark the beginning of the game. To avoid any spoilers, the demo will be a completely separate event from the main story. It will take place in the same world but in a different place. [/p][p]The demo release should be announced soon![/p]

notes.title: Update Note: Drawings replace texts in-game
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The in-game text (which previously appeared when clicking on an item in the top black bar) has been completely replaced with drawings (except in the settings interface ofc).

Recent playtests has shown that this significantly improves the gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45439988/7996f42a3f2de5bf542ea8d38a7475937a290a69.jpg[/img]

See you in the swamp! 🐸
